title: Sliding session expiry via token refresh
pr_description: Adds refresh_token() so clients can extend a session without re-entering a password. Includes a test for the new endpoint.

defects.description: The UPDATE has no WHERE clause, so refreshing one session extends the expiry of every token in the system, including other users' sessions.

Uses naive local time instead of timezone.utc. The stored naive ISO string later makes authenticate() compare naive vs aware datetimes and raise TypeError, breaking every refreshed session on next use.
The added test only asserts refresh_token returns the token. It never authenticates afterwards or checks the expiry moved, so it passes despite both bugs above.
